name: Shadowfang Keep: Archmage Arugal never curses a player who fights him alone
contract: Archmage Arugal 4275 is the Shadowfang Keep (map 33, expansion 0) encounter boss. His SmartAI casts two charms in
event phase 1: Arugal's Curse 7621 at a random non-top-threat target (event 5, every 25-27.5 s) and the Ascension
kit's Curse of Arugal 2102679 at a random player (event 9001, first after 10.2-12.2 s, then every 25-27 s; the
kit's aggro event sets phase 1). Both carry SPELL_AURA_MOD_CHARM on effect 0 (client Spell.dbc, patch-T.MPQ).
Requested rule: a player who is alone, even inside a group, and solos Arugal is never mind-controlled. Arugal is
still exempt from the vanilla dungeon boss rule that spares tanks and healers (arugal-curse-still-takes-healer),
but BossControlTargeting.h now lets him charm only while at least two players are on his threat list.
The two players group in Stormwind; only 'solo' enters the instance first. Arugal is summoned at its own stats on
a Shadow Port 7586 landing point. 'solo' engages him and stops attacking after 3 s, so he stays above the 50%
health teleport that ends phase 1, and holds his attention for 45 s: at least two event 9001 windows and one
event 5 window. Neither charm may be applied in that time. Then 'partner' enters, joins the threat list and
Arugal must apply Curse of Arugal within 60 s, which proves the solo silence comes from the lone-player rule and
not from a broken timer. Both players arrive facing east (orientation 0), toward the boss that the summon step
places 3 yd along +x, so their swings pass the melee facing check. Player health fixtures keep both alive; the
players are level 26 humans, matching the boss.
